Depreciation, Nutrition, and QCPU detail totals include their transfer/bond other financing lines. Activities fund recorded per account (Exhibit I). Exhibit F is the General Fund components schedule (not recorded, duplicates Exhibit G/D); its row labels for taxes appear mislabeled. Balance sheet: Exhibit A (p1), cash basis, no liabilities.
